_comment: Example /worker/jobs/{job_id}/result payload for a repo smoke-test job (API.md section 9: a python_script or shell job running experiments/tools/repo_smoke.py). Per API.md: 'Its result metrics must carry {import_ok, tests_passed, tests_failed}.' This example is static mode (no --install), so metrics only carries what API.md requires, with null for the two install-only fields; files carries the full smoke.json. Repo values here are entirely synthetic placeholders.
